10266|3852bbda.name: Ug'thok
10266|3852bbda.text: Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.

10278|b24d3eb1.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|b24d3eb1.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

11025|8faa4e47.name: Mukdrak
11025|8faa4e47.text: I know a few things. You want me to show you?

11025|a40c1827.name: Mukdrak
11025|a40c1827.text: I like to build stuff. Of course, I like to blow stuff up even more!

11025|f03c89ad.name: Mukdrak
11025|f03c89ad.text: You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

11031|7fb84865.name: Franklin Lloyd
11031|7fb84865.text: Let's see how competent you are, shall we? If you perform this task to my liking, I'll spend the time to teach you!

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1950|aa9cd6e2.name: Rane Yorick
1950|aa9cd6e2.text: My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

276801|24ed9d67.name: Swift Orange Raptor
276801|24ed9d67.text: <The raptor bares its teeth at you.>

2857|31f4573e.name: Thund
2857|31f4573e.text: You know who's really smart? Nogg! Smarter than me, even. You go tell Nogg Thund sent you! You can find him by the control panel over there.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3143|004c594f.name: Gornek
3143|004c594f.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a $c worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3143|e14f5e15.name: Gornek
3143|e14f5e15.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3153|640f312b.name: Frang
3153|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3171|9d35dc4d.name: Thotar
3171|9d35dc4d.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

3174|7befd912.name: Dwukk
3174|7befd912.text: I hear one comment about waterfowl, and you will be eating through a tube.

3184|c7dd471a.name: Miao'zan
3184|c7dd471a.text: You got the look of someone wantin' adventure. Me, I had enough of that by the time we trolls came here. Now I take each day as it comes, an' I train other folks to handle adventures for me.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3191|b48f927f.name: Cook Torka
3191|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

3296|2213d915.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|2213d915.text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|5516f117.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|5516f117.text: In the Cleft of Shadow Kor'ghan is waiting with shears sharper than a guard's sword.

3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3352|08830bac.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3352|fd7e1800.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|fd7e1800.text: I have much knowledge to impress upon you, $c. You must learn to hunt with honor.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3407|08830bac.name: Sian'dur
3407|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3407|2a1798f1.name: Sian'dur
3407|2a1798f1.text: Come learn the ways of the $c. Pride, honor, and tradition.

3412|fe9433e2.name: Nogg
3412|fe9433e2.text: Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3620|0e051c59.name: Harruk
3620|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3706|10137e12.name: Tai'jin
3706|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

3707|10137e12.name: Ken'jai
3707|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5624|072251a6.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|072251a6.text: Graham Van Talen in Rogues' Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

5941|c2467ddc.name: Lau'Tiki
5941|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5953|5b1aca6d.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|5b1aca6d.text: Seek out Miao'zan in Sen'jin Village to the south.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

7953|de02093f.name: Xar'Ti
7953|de02093f.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

2383-progress.name: Frang
2383-progress.text: What's that you have there?  A parchment?  You're not a scholar, I hope...
2383-progress.title: Simple Parchment

3085-progress.name: Ken'jai
3085-progress.text: So ya made it... good good! Da spirits tol' me you be comin' to see Ken'jai soon enough. Let me be one o' da first to welcome ya to da Valley of Trials. Dis place not be your home fer long, but while it is, why dontcha make da best o' it.
3085-progress.title: Hallowed Tablet

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

6082-progress.name: Thotar
6082-progress.text: Were you able to tame the scorpid?
6082-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6083-progress.name: Thotar
6083-progress.text: You need to practice in order to gain the skills you need to effectively control your pet. Have you tamed a surf crawler?
6083-progress.title: Taming the Beast

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97902-accept.name: Brakk
97902-accept.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902-accept.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97902-complete.name: Mukdrak
97902-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97902-complete.title: Camping 101: Engineering
